Class TimeConverterFactory

Namespace
SilverCraft.CSCore

GetTimeConverterForSourceType(Type)

Gets the TimeConverter for the specified sourceType.

public TimeConverter GetTimeConverterForSourceType(Type sourceType)

Parameters

sourceType Type

The Type to get the associated TimeConverter for.

Returns

TimeConverter

The best TimeConverter for the specified sourceType.

Remarks

The GetTimeConverterForSourceType(Type) chooses the best TimeConverter for the specified sourceType. If there is no TimeConverterAttribute applied to the IAudioSource object (the sourceType), it looks up the inheritance hierarchy (interfaces included) of the IAudioSource object and searches for all registered source types. If there is a match it returns the associated TimeConverter. If there are more or less than one match BUT no TimeConverterAttribute it throws an exception.

Exceptions

ArgumentException

Specified type is no AudioSource.;type or No registered time converter for the specified source type was found. or Multiple possible time converters, for the specified source type, were found. Specify which time converter to use, through the TimeConverterAttribute.

RegisterTimeConverterForSourceType<TSource>(TimeConverter)

Registers a new TimeConverter for a specific source type.

public void RegisterTimeConverterForSourceType<TSource>(TimeConverter timeConverter) where TSource : IAudioSource

Parameters

timeConverter TimeConverter

The TimeConverter to register.

Type Parameters

TSource

The source type.

Remarks

The TimeConverterFactory class uses the source type to find choose the best TimeConverter for an IAudioSource. For more information, see GetTimeConverterForSourceType(Type).

Exceptions

ArgumentNullException

timeConverter is null.

ArgumentException

There is already a TimeConverter registered for the specified TSource.
